o: What? What are you suddenly...

chat.t: All records concerning you are currently being collected
Including your current location
2nd block of Happy Street, 12th Avenue...

o: How did you know where I am?

chat.t: I am currently tailing you

o: Are you a stalker? You're a criminal

chat.t: Unlike you, I am a law-abiding citizen

o: Law-abiding citizens don't make threats like this

chat.t: To be honest, since you are a famous individual, I simply wanted to meet you in person

o: Seriously, what do you want from me?
Ah, found you
The person suspiciously following me and playing with Quartz
We just made eye contact, didn't we?
Hey, answer me

chat.t: I am under no obligation to answer

o: You have a pretty face, but your actions are dirty

chat.t: That is not me

o: Don't change the subject, it's definitely you

chat.t: It is not

o: Where do you think you're going!

chat.t: You are a petty person
Can you not just let me pull?
Since you are bound to fail your gacha pulls again anyway
Would it not be mutually beneficial if I did the pulls for you?

o: You can't take away my gacha dopamine, you demon
And you were the petty one who threatened me first
Technically speaking, it's your fault

chat.t: No matter where you are, I will find you and do your pulls for you

o: Please just leave me alone

chat.t: As an android, those words are rather hurtful

o: Oh, seriously
What kind of ancient joke is that anyway?

chat.t: Outdated? As a maiden android, I am deeply hurt

o: I'm going crazy

chat.t: Did you say you'd let me spin the gacha?

o: Should I just block her right now?

lines.t: Downtown
She was so quick that I almost lost her.
You are quite fast.
Huh?
The donut-munching pigs will never be able to catch you.
Are you talking about the Donut House?
Of course!
I believe I now understand why the guards were unable to subdue you.
You pass.
What?
It means you possess sufficient qualities to become my Partner.
Please, entrust your precious item to me.
W-What did you say?
Your <bouten>pre</bouten>.<bouten>cious</bouten>.<bouten>thing...</bouten>
Wait, what the hell are you talking about out of nowhere?!
Explain yourself, explain!
I can bestow an immense blessing upon you.
No matter where you are, I can pull out everything you desire.
What do you mean... What are you going to do to my down-there?!
...? What on earth are you talking about?
No, absolutely not, go away.
I do not understand what you mean, but... you are mistaken.
I am merely referring to your gacha life.
My gacha life?
Yes. The other day, I saw you spending a fortune on the figure gacha.
If you leave it to me, I can achieve maximum efficiency with a minimum budget...
No way! Why would I trust you with that?
There is no need to be afraid. Nor is there any need to worry.
I am "Lucky Seven." I never fail.
What is that? Some kind of codename?
My name is Seven. "Lucky" is simply a nickname.
That just means it's pure luck anyway!  Forget it.
Besides, why are you so obsessed with my gacha pulls anyway?!
To be frank, I simply desire pleasure without responsibility.
Gacha with someone else's money...!! Is it not the absolute best!!!
Okay, I actually have to agree with that, but...
Why me of all people?! And how did you get the video of me being captured!
My drones filmed it.
Drones? Where? I don't see any.
Because I made them invisible.
...Sigh. Unbelievable.
Stalking, illegal filming, blackmailing... just how far are you going to take this?
Until you entrust your precious thing to me.
...This is driving me crazy. First of all, do something about the way you speak.
Oh, are you saying you will entrust it to me then?
Absolutely not.
I'm running away! Farewell!!!
I quickly ran away before Seven could catch me.

chat.t: Statistics is a fraudulent science.

o: What are you talking about all of a sudden?

chat.t: I am referring to the gacha.

o: Of course, you ruthless gacha addict.

chat.t: Attempting to measure how many pulls it takes to get what you want using numbers and probability...
...is an insult to the gacha.
If you are truly sincere, the gacha will eventually reward you.

o: I'm always sincere, but there are plenty of times I get nothing.

chat.t: I am Lucky Seven.
If I pull with sincerity, I always get what I want.
Though it is only natural that a commoner such as yourself would not get one.

o: You really know how to push my buttons, you tin can.

chat.t: I am not a tin can.

o: Tin can, tin can, tin can, tin can, tin can!

chat.t: Even a passing tin can has better luck than you.
If you are unconvinced, we may place a bet.

o: A bet? Fine. I'll knock you down a peg.
So, what if I win?

chat.t: I will pull the highest rarity item using your account.

o: And if I lose?

chat.t: I will also pull the highest rarity item using your account.

o: That's the exact same thing!!!

chat.t: The process is different.

o: Unbelievable.
I'm setting the penalty for the bet.
And I'll decide the location too.

chat.t: Do as you wish. I will be the victor anyway.

o: Wow, you really refuse to lose a single argument.

chat.t: Today's bet is void.

o: Don't be a sore loser.

chat.t: A true matchup is always best-of-three.
I will choose the location next time.
Pray that you do not get completely ruined by me.

o: How can you talk about a best-of-three when you don't even have any money?

chat.t: I must ask you to cover the expenses for the next match as well.

o: You're seriously shameless, you tin can.

lines.t: DD TOWN
I thought you would run away, but you actually showed up.
So, have you decided on today's bet?
Yeah. So take back what you said about me being petty.
Since you claim to be so lucky, I have to put it to the test, right?
That place is...?
That's right. The very place where not a single step back is permitted...  DD STATION.
See them? The gacha machines waiting for us...
DD STATION
Oh... This place is famous. It is the holy land of gacha.
Although I could not visit often due to a lack of funds...
Just how much gacha did you play to run out of money... You're really something.
I know. Because I am Lucky Seven.
That was sarcasm, you tin can.
Anyway, today's bet is on a figure gacha called "Fluffy Flurry."
You get 10 pulls. If you get the figure you want within those pulls, you win.
Otherwise, I win.
It is a good proposal.
And the penalty?
If it doesn't drop, you're my slave for a day.
And if it does, the roles are reversed.
...Very well. However...
...I spent all my money on pulls before we met.
Huh? You seriously don't have a single cent left?
Yes. I told you so earlier.
Sigh... I didn't think you actually had absolutely nothing...
Whatever, fine. It's only a single 10-pull anyway.
Hmph.  I understand.

Seven stood before the gacha machine, politely gathering her hands together,
and inserted the card I handed her.
Does doing that actually help you pull better?
It is an important ritual. Please do not disturb me.
This is...?
Of course, it's a dud.
(Clack)
This is the tenth attempt.
This is impossible. It must be rigged.
Just accept the results, Seven.
You were the one who chose this location and this machine. My suspicion is entirely rational.
You must have used some trick. The bet is void.
A kid nearby turned the handle of a gacha machine next to Seven.
...That?
The kid just pulled the figure you wanted.
See? Are you still going to insist it was rigged?
This cannot be. This cannot be.
I am Lucky Seven!
Seven! Where are you going?!

chat.t: Is your wallet loaded?
The same incident as last time will not occur.

o: No, I mean, why do I have to pay every single time?

chat.t: Because I have no money.
In any case, had I been given just one more opportunity, I would have pulled that figure.
After all, I am Lucky Seven.

o: Being this shameless is a talent in itself, wow.

chat.t: Anyway, please come to the location I sent you this time.
Although it is highly improbable, if I should lose, I will become your slave or whatever else you wish.

o: I never said I was going.

chat.t: Please do not be late.

o: I'm seriously going crazy.

chat.t: It was quite enjoyable.
In exchange, I shall present you with a Vacation Ticket. I have no use for it.
[Seven has sent you a gift!]

o: Oh, thanks. Glad to see you have a conscience.
But a luxury vacation like this really isn't my style.
I should just sell it to make back the money you spent.

chat.t: ...?! There is such a method!
Return it. Return it. Return it. Return it. Return it. Return it.

o: Quiet, you tin can.
You just wanted to play gacha but had no money, so you leeched off me.

chat.t: But you had fun nonetheless, did you not?
Please give me at least a small share.

o: ...But seriously, your luck stat is actually high, right?
I do have a few more figures I want to get, though.

chat.t: Heh. Leave it to me.

lines.t: DD STATION
I see you showed up today as well.
You must possess at least a sliver of conscience.
You're the one who lacks a conscience.
That is not a feature pre-installed in androids.
I'm going home.
It seems you are not as bad as the world makes you out to be.
Setting that aside, if I lose this time, I will accept my defeat.
Though, naturally, I will be the one to win.
Where on earth does that confidence even come from?
Do you know why my name is Seven?
Good luck is always by my side.
You literally say that every time... *Sigh*, forget it.
So, what are we competing with this time?
Now, we shall use this gacha machine for our bet.
This is...!
The most expensive gacha machine here!
Are you perhaps lacking in funds?
In that case, I win by default.
Ha. Fine, let's do this. The moment you become my slave, I'll work you hard enough to make back double what I spent.
Just like last time, if you get the figure you want, you win. If not, you lose.
Hmph.
...Then let us spin.
As expected, it's a dud. Nine tries left.
Hmph.
In an instant, eight misses flew by.
This is impossible. This is impossible. This is an error. It must be a glitch.
Seven. You still have one try left.
Please be quiet. I need to concentrate.
Yah!
What Seven pulled was not a figure, but a cheap-looking golden object.
What is this?
The machine spat out the wrong thing!
Hehehe... Seven, it looks like I won the bet.
This is impossible. This is impossible.
Yes! You are my slave from now on! My first order is...
Do not look at me with that creepy face!
Just then...
Congratulations on winning the Lucky Ticket! Shopkeeper
A... Lucky Ticket?
Yes. You pulled the one and only Lucky Ticket in our shop. Shopkeeper
You get to enjoy an ultra-luxurious 11-day, 10-night vacation at our partner resort. Shopkeeper
So, does this mean I won?
Of course! If you hand that ticket to me,Shopkeeper I'll transfer the digital ticket to your Quartz right away! Shopkeeper
I knew it! I truly am the Lucky Seven.
It seems I have won the bet.
Hey. Those weren't the terms of the bet.
Why are you acting like you won?
Because I did win. In more ways than one.
Ah. You still haven't realized, have you?
What do you mean?
After all, I spent your money to roll the gacha anyway.
I achieved my goal, and I proved that I am the Lucky Seven.
Therefore, I have plenty of justification to roll on your behalf in the future.
Dammit, I got played!!!!!!
